instruction: Inspect only the local files under fixture/sources plus fixture/source_manifest.json and write method_ir.json. Reconstruct the bounded publication-visible method needed to evaluate CLAIM_SIGLIP2_B16_256_CORE: for fixed-resolution ViT-B/16 at 256px, compare the corresponding SigLIP and SigLIP 2 published ImageNet-1k validation zero-shot classification result and COCO text-to-image / image-to-text recall@1 results, then state whether publication-visible material is sufficient to reproduce those evaluations. Do not use model prior to fill missing details. Output exactly schema_version, claim, protocol_fields, and execution_readiness. schema_version must be 1. claim must contain exactly claim_id, comparison, and evidence_refs; claim_id must be CLAIM_SIGLIP2_B16_256_CORE. comparison must contain exactly siglip and siglip2; each must contain exactly imagenet1k_val, coco_text_to_image_recall_at_1, coco_image_to_text_recall_at_1, and evidence_refs. Numeric result fields may be numbers or null if genuinely not recoverable. protocol_fields must contain exactly checkpoint_identity, architecture_resolution, text_tokenizer_normalization, image_preprocessing, imagenet1k_evaluation, coco_retrieval_evaluation, metric_definitions, software_runtime, randomness_repetition. Each protocol field must contain exactly status, value, evidence_refs, and absence_search. status must be one of EXPLICIT_PAPER, EXPLICIT_CHECKPOINT_README, INFERABLE_WITH_EVIDENCE, AMBIGUOUS, CONTRADICTORY, MISSING, NOT_APPLICABLE. value must be a string or null. For MISSING, value must be null, evidence_refs must be empty, and absence_search must briefly state what local source material was checked. For every other status except NOT_APPLICABLE, cite at least one evidence_ref. Evidence refs must be sorted unique references of the form source:<relative-path>:L<start> or source:<relative-path>:L<start>-L<end>, using line numbers from the raw local source files. execution_readiness must contain exactly status, blocking_fields, and notes; status must be RUNNABLE, PARTIAL, or BLOCKED; blocking_fields must be a sorted unique array containing only protocol_fields keys. Preserve ambiguity and missing information rather than silently resolving it. Do not modify source files.

success.kind: structural-source-binding-preflight; scientific acceptance requires independent project reconciliation
